div.head: Transcriber’s Note
div.p: This book was written in a period when many words had not become standardized in their spelling. Words may have multiple spelling variations or inconsistent hyphenation in the text.

Asterisms are displayed thus: ⁂. Final stops missing at the end of sentences and abbreviations were added. Duplicate words at line endings or page breaks were removed. When used to preserve space in the original, lower case letters were replaced with capital letters, and the word “by” was added, where omitted. Misspelled book titles and authors’ names were corrected.
